title: The Interview
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 2. Human VOA audio; WorldVoice provides only a selected, bilingual transcript excerpt; read the full conversation on the credited official page. No sentence timings have been verified. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.text: So, as I said at the meeting last week, I have new assignments for everyone at The Studio. Anna, you're good at asking questions. So, I want you to go back to hosting and reporting.
dialogue.translation_ar: كما قلت في اجتماع الأسبوع الماضي، لدي مهام جديدة للجميع في الاستوديو. آنا، أنت بارعة في طرح الأسئلة، وأريدك أن تعودي إلى تقديم البرامج والتغطية الإخبارية.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.text: You're also a team player. So, I want you team up with someone ...
dialogue.translation_ar: وأنت أيضًا تحبين العمل الجماعي، لذا أريدك أن تتعاوني مع شخص...

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.text: ... someone who is very "different" from you.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: That sounds ... what do you mean "different"?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.text: Well, you are very cheerful, you're a people person. I want you to team up with someone who ... isn't.
dialogue.translation_ar: أنت مرحة واجتماعية جدًا، وأريدك أن تعملي مع شخص ليس كذلك.
